city.help: City name for live weather and astronomical clock

lang.help: Language for the weather panel and countdowns

quality.help: Automatic: the still picture is sharp, animated rain and snow are half resolution. Always low: half resolution all the time (least memory)

animBattery.text: Animiraj i na bateriji / Animate on battery too
animBattery.help: Off: on battery power the picture is always still, also in rain and snow

fps.text: Sličice/s za kišu i snijeg / Frame rate in rain & snow
fps.help: Used only while rain, snow, hail or a storm moves, and only on mains power; otherwise the picture stays still (redrawn once a minute) to save GPU and battery

cardCorner.help: Which corner of the scene display the weather card sits in

layout.help: Span: one scene over all displays. Use it with Lively's own 'Span' wallpaper layout.

spanDisplays.text: Broj zaslona / Displays side by side
spanDisplays.help: Span: used only if Lively cannot report the displays' real layout: how many equal-width displays the wallpaper is spread over

sceneDisplay.help: Span: which display (counted from the left) shows the terrace and the weather card. 0 = automatic (the primary display)
